o.norm: a bit of a back door in!
checks expected order, and the + indicates that element had a next sibling at time of emission

i.norm: Appends a short token describing {@code el} to {@code actual}. Token format: tagName[#id][text][+]; - #id present when the element carries an id attribute - [text] present when the element has non-empty own text - + present when the element had a next sibling at emission time - ; always appended as a delimiter between tokens
HTML with a title, nested divs, paragraphs, and a span — exercises the streaming emission order (children before parents, siblings in document order).
Emission is depth-first: each element appears after all its descendants. The "+" marker confirms the element had a next sibling when it was emitted.
